in_hebrew.name: Lindie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lindie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Lindisfarne, an English island associated with St. Aidan, who brought Christianity to the Anglo-Saxons. The name may mean 'light' or 'fragrant'. In the Bible, Linden trees are mentioned in Song of Solomon.
